question: On 10 April 2023, the Government of India launched tourism infrastructure and amenities in villages through the 'Vibrant Villages Programme'.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Border Villages**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Government of India** launched the **Vibrant Villages Programme** on **10 April 2023**.
 
• The programme aims to develop **tourism infrastructure and amenities** in villages located near the **India's borders**.
 
• The initiative is focused on **boosting connectivity**, providing modern facilities, and improving the livelihood of people in **remote border villages**.
